questions.question: A wise teacher in the Bible says to keep the king's command. What reason does he give?

answers.text: Because of your oath before God
Because the king pays your wages
Because the people are watching you

questions.question: A wise teacher says the wicked do not fear God, so their days will lengthen like a shadow. True or false?
After seeing that life under the sun often seems unfair, what does a wise teacher commend?
After seeing every work of God, what does a wise teacher say about a man and the work done under the sun?

answers.text: He is unable to comprehend it
He can master it with effort
He can explain it to others
